modules.name: Environment-Aware Prisma Data Architecture
modules.objective: Use Prisma SQLite for Local development and Prisma PostgreSQL on isolated Neon databases for Staging/Production, with automated shared-schema parity.
boundaries: Local SQLite files must be gitignored.
No Local reuse of Staging or Production credentials.
No Staging/Production credential reuse across hosted environments.
No production migration during Shopify release.
acceptance_criteria: Staging and Production Neon identities remain isolated.
Session shop lookup remains indexed in hosted PostgreSQL.
completion_evidence: Hosted PostgreSQL schema contract and Session.shop index are CI-validated.
Local SQLite schema and migration path are CI-validated.
Shared Local/cloud Prisma model parity is CI-validated by App Validation #271.
Staging and Production retain isolated Neon PostgreSQL identities.
update_notes: Database architecture is complete at repository level; environment runtime acceptance is handled by Local/Staging promotion gates.

modules.name: Four-Tier Shopify Billing and Entitlements
modules.objective: Provide four stable subscription tiers with a shared 10-day trial contract and server-side entitlement resolution.
boundaries: Exactly four stable IDs: starter, growth, pro, unlimited.
Do not expose unimplemented options as available runtime capabilities.
Production real billing is only used after guarded release.
security_responsibilities: Validate exact subscription identity, price, interval, trial and test mode.
Do not trust client-provided plan entitlements.
acceptance_criteria: New manual Billing API subscriptions use 10-day trials.
Plan changes use Shopify replacement behavior.
Legacy USD 55/5-day subscriptions retain compatible access.
